calls.statement: SELECT week_ending_date, store_key, product_key, closing_units, closing_value, receipts_units, adjustment_units, etl_loaded_at FROM fact_stock_week WHERE store_key = 30 AND product_key = 11 AND week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-08-30' ORDER BY week_ending_date, etl_loaded_at

SELECT d.fiscal_week_end_date AS wk_end, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold, count(*) AS n FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE f.store_key = 30 AND f.product_key = 11 AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-24' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key)) AS combos, max(week_ending_date) AS max_wk, max(etl_loaded_at) AS max_load FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date = DATE '2026-10-04'
